description: This PHP class defines a console command for restoring a database to a specified savepoint within the OrangeHRM testing framework. It includes command name configuration, argument handling, and execution logic that interacts with a database backup service.

classes.name: RestoreDatabaseToSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command to restore the database to a specific savepoint during tests.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name identifier used in CLI.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and arguments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the restore operation and outputs success message.
